description: What depends on a file or symbol, and how risky changing it is: direct and transitive dependents, confidence lanes, evidence and a risk band. Results are import/soft-lane based — coverageLimitations lists classes it cannot see (DI containers, string-keyed registries, event buses, template/i18n refs, runtime-loaded config, generated-code consumers). Call this before editing or deleting code you did not write. Use intent 'delete' when removing rather than modifying. affectedFiles and testsLikelyAffected are bounded (default 50).

id.description: Workspace-relative file path, or symbol name as returned by find_symbol.

intent.description: Emphasis. 'delete' weighs orphaned code more heavily. Default 'edit'.

kind.description: Whether `id` names a file or a symbol.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (default 50, max 500). The response reports totalCount and truncated so you can tell whether you saw everything.

path.description: File declaring the symbol, when kind is 'symbol'.
